title: ICON 1.5 — First Steps
description: Where the ICON tools live: quick guide, characters, compendiums, combat and chat.

steps.title: Welcome to ICON 1.5
steps.content: This short tour shows where the ICON tools are in Foundry. Use the arrows at the bottom (or the ← → keys) to move between steps, and the ✕ to leave at any time. You can replay every tour from Settings → Tours.

steps.title: Quick Guide
steps.content: The book in the token controls opens the ICON Quick Guide: how a turn works, pictures of every area (blasts, bursts, lines, arcs, auras), the glossary and an FAQ of edge cases. It is also at the top of every character sheet, and in the header menu (⋮) of every actor sheet.

steps.title: Characters
steps.content: Player characters, foes, legends, summons and clock boards live in the Actors tab. To make a character: Create Actor → Player Character, then open it and follow the Character Setup Wizard.

steps.title: Encounter Designer
steps.content: GM only. The Encounter button builds a fight within the encounter budget (p.292): pick foes, Elites and reserves, then place them on the scene in one go.

steps.title: Compendiums
steps.content: Everything from the book is here, ready to drag: Jobs, Bonds and Bond Powers, Gear Kits, Relics, Foes, Legends, Summons, Foe Abilities and the system Macros. Drag a Job Template onto a character sheet to give it that job.

steps.title: Combat Tracker
steps.content: ICON has no initiative: sides alternate, and the players choose who goes first (p.87). Each row shows one pip per activation left — click it to take the turn. The Combat tour explains the tracker in detail.

steps.title: Chat Cards
steps.content: Rolls, abilities, traits and relics are posted here as cards. Attack and damage cards list your targeted tokens. A damage card has an Apply button per target that takes Armor, Vigor, Cover and Resistance into account for you.

steps.title: House rules
steps.content: GM only. ICON 1.5 plays by the book by default. The optional rules (Dust to heal Burdens, Heroic / Routine rolls) are in Configure Settings → ICON 1.5; the House Rules tour walks you through them.

steps.title: Next steps
steps.content: That's the map. Next, take the Character Sheet tour (it needs a player character to exist) and the Combat tour. All of them are in Settings → Tours, under ICON 1.5.
